records.questionText: How does the role of the entrepreneur differ from that of the manager in a business?
records.sourceSchemeBlock:
How does the role of the entrepreneur differ from that of a manager in a
                business?                                                  9 marks

        1.      An entrepreneur comes up with an idea/ a manager is responsible for implementing
                      it/a particular function/running the business.
        2.      An entrepreneur takes risks whereas a manager does not necessarily take a risk.
        3.      An entrepreneur works for themselves whereas a manager is often employed by
                  others.
        4.      An entrepreneur may not have specific training whereas a manager has specific
                  training in one or more areas.
        5.      An entrepreneur has the potential to make high profits whereas a manager is paid a
                   set salary.
        6.      An entrepreneur sets up the business and the manager runs it.

                                                                        Contrasts must be evident.
